cmd:
unset CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR AGENTIC_OBSERVE; mkdir -p factory/specs .agentic; printf '%s' '{"observability":{"enabled":true}}' > .agentic/config.json; printf -- '---
id: 001
title: waits-on-real
status: specd
depends_on: 002
---
body
' > factory/specs/001-a.md; printf -- '---
id: 002
title: dep-building
status: building
---
body
' > factory/specs/002-b.md; printf -- '---
id: 003
title: waits-on-typo
status: specd
depends_on: 099
---
body
' > factory/specs/003-c.md; source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh"; if CLAIMED=$(tracker_claim specd building build-loop 2>/dev/null); then EC=0; else EC=$?; fi; EV=$(cat .agentic/observability/events-*.jsonl 2>/dev/null | jq -cs '[.[] | select(.event=="tracker_skip")] | first'); jq -n --argjson ec "$EC" --arg s1 "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/001-a.md status)" --arg s3 "$(_tracker_field factory/specs/003-c.md status)" --argjson ev "${EV:-null}" '{ec: $ec, s1: $s1, s3: $s3, ev: $ev}'
_note: two waiting specs (one on a building dep, one on a nonexistent id — typo protection), nothing claimable: exit 1, statuses untouched, and ONE tracker_skip event naming both. Lock must be released (statuses readable after)
